Osric asks you to take out a Stone Summit boss named [[Inar Frostbite]], who is blocking the road to Borlis Pass with his men.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Clear the [[Stone Summit]] blocking the entrance to [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]].
* See [[Beccum Reedly]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
All you need to do to complete this quest  is kill the Stone Summit [[mesmer]] [[boss]] [[Inar Frostbite]], who is at the very far end of the road to Borlis Pass in [[Traveler's Vale]]. If you have already been to Borlis Pass, it is quickest to start from there; otherwise, travel south from [[Yak's Bend]].

The most direct route from Yak's Bend is populated with [[Snow Ettin]]s, and if you also have the quests [[Shiverpeak Stragglers]] and/or [[The Road to Borlis Pass]] active, there will be large numbers of Stone Summit dwarves on the road. To avoid them, you can simply skirt around via the east road that goes towards the [[Ascalon Foothills]] entrance, as shown on the map to the right. Otherwise, [[pull]] carefully when multiple groups are close to each other and be wary of any patrols in the area. You can also take advantage of the [[Caravan Guard]]s that sometimes travel through the area.

Inar Frostbite spawns with two [[Summit Axe Wielder]]s, but can be pulled away from them. As with other Stone Summit mesmers, be prepared for [[Empathy]] and [[Shatter Enchantment]]. After killing Inar, continue on through the Shiverpeak [[centaur]]s to Borlis Pass and claim the reward from [[Beccum Reedly]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"The Shiverpeak Mountains are not known to grant pity on travelers. Seems a storm has blown in from the east and settled around '''Borlis Pass'''. And as if that wasn't enough, a Stone Summit leader calling himself '''[[Inar Frostbite]]''' has taken advantage of the situation and ordered his men to block the entrance to the pass. There is no other way to get supplies through. I believe he plans to wait until we're cold and hungry, then start a push toward Yak's Bend. You'd have to be as blind as a Dolyak not to see what will happen up there if we don't do something now.''

:''I need you to lead a party up there and take out Frostbite's force. Can you do it?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Consider them dead!
| decline = I'll stay here by the warm fire.
| ask = Without a way to move supplies through these mountains, our people will never reach [[Kryta]]. Those already on the way will starve to death. I'm counting on you to take out the '''Stone Summit''' blocking '''Borlis Pass'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Beccum Reedly
:''"I'm relieved to hear you cleared the road; I didn't want to have to tell the refugees to boil their leathers for supper. Ever since this storm started up, the Stone Summit have been causing us nothing but trouble. They constantly raid our caravans and pillage our supply trains. These mountain passes are trying enough for the weak and the old without their constant harassment."''

:''"Now on to matters concerning our prince..."''

==Notes==
* Due to the large amount of additional foes this quest spawns in Traveler's Vale, it is not uncommon for runners to request players to abandon this quest before running from Yak's Bend.

==Trivia==
* The name of this quest may be a reference to the short film "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=55uCWGZhiGQ Shaft of Light]" by Bill Tomlinson, which was first shown at the Sundance Film Festival in 1997.
